title: Find exact top-k neighbors in chunks
prompt: Find exact cosine top-k gallery row IDs without allocating N*M scores. Scan corpus chunks and keep N*k candidates. Break ties by gallery row ID. Optional exclude[N] omits one ID per query; k is clamped to available documents. Return (IDs,scores).
